start: Signed in as the owner; member page of a member with a running PT pack and no session marked today; internet on

user_sees: A line with sessions used and left
must_not: The card missing for a member with a running pack
A count from a cancelled pack

user_sees: Today shows first under "Sessions used on"
Sessions left goes down by one
must_not: Two sessions taken by two fast taps
The session taken off the newer pack while the older one still has sessions

start: Signed in as the owner; member page; every session of the running PT pack is used

user_sees: "All <n> PT sessions used. Time to renew."
Button "Renew PT" (only while that PT plan is still on sale)
must_not: "Mark session" still offered with none left

user_sees: The sell sheet opens with the PT plan already picked
must_not: The sheet opening on the gym plan
The picked plan kept for the next plain "Sell membership"

start: Signed in as the owner; member page; a PT session is already marked today

user_sees: Nothing happens; the button is greyed
must_not: A second session on the same day

user_sees: "Mark session" and "Undo last session" are greyed and say they need internet
must_not: A session marked on this device only and lost later

steps.action: Open a member whose PT pack ended with sessions left
user_sees: "<plan> · Ended on <day> with <n> sessions left" with button "Extend"
must_not: "Mark session" on an ended pack

start: Signed in as the owner; member page; running PT pack, nothing marked today

must_not: No way to take back a wrong tap on the same day

user_sees: Sessions left back to the number before
must_not: An older session removed in place of today's
The count going below zero or above the pack size
Two pills for the same day
